svg.title: Senior ColdFusion Consultant roadmap
svg.desc: 01 CFML and the Platform: Adobe ColdFusion, Lucee and BoxLang, Versions and support lifecycle, Modern CFML, Frameworks, CommandBox and CFConfig, Testing with TestBox, CFML coding standards; 02 JVM, Performance and Diagnostics: Request lifecycle, JVM memory and garbage collection, Thread dumps and heap dumps, Application monitoring, Database access and connection pools, Caching, Load testing; 03 Security and Hardening: Security updates and patching, Server lockdown, Secure CFML coding, Secrets and configuration, Security review, Red Zone work; 04 Maintaining Legacy Applications: Understanding inherited code, Characterization tests, Applying updates safely, Monitoring and alerting, Incident response, Runbooks and documentation, Support agreements, Using AI tools on inherited code; 05 Assessing Legacy Applications: Framework detection, Architecture mapping, Technical debt scoring, Security assessment, Performance assessment, The assessment report; 06 Modernization Strategy: Modernization options, Decision matrix, Total cost of ownership, Strangler fig pattern, Phased roadmap, When not to modernize; 07 Upgrades and Migration: Adobe ColdFusion upgrades, Migrating to Lucee, Lucee upgrades, Compatibility testing, Configuration migration, Data, sessions and files, Cutover and rollback, Evaluating BoxLang; 08 Cloud, Containers and DevOps: Containers for CFML, Licensing in containers and the cloud, Sessions and shared state, CI/CD for CFML, Cloud platforms, Infrastructure as code; 09 Modernizing the Application: REST APIs in CFML, Separating the front end, Accessibility, AI features in CFML, Background work; 10 Client Consulting and Delivery: Discovery workshops, Estimation, Proposals and statements of work, Client communication, Presenting to decision makers, Running the engagement, Handover and knowledge transfer, Leading and mentoring
svg.text: Using AI tools on inherited code
Licensing in containers and the cloud
Every topic has a guide in the stage pages next to this image.
